Major Maintenance 
 Procedures (P1H12000)
موافقة تاريخ: 30 April 2006

تاريخ المراد مراجعتها:

مقدمة

This document outlines the major maintenance 
procedures P1, which must be performed every 12000 operating hours as indicated 
by H12000 in the title block.
البيانات الفنية:
Lub Oil System Components

Duplex 
 filters

Automatic 
 lubricating oil filter
Oil cooler

Volumetric 
 motor - Driven gear pump type pxb 50 lubrification oil transfer

Volumetric motor - Driven screw 
 pump type L 3 MG 125 / 50 lubrification oil

Hand 
 pump

Alfa 
 laval lup oil purifying system

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pimp motor.
Disconnect electric terrninal of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery 
 and suctior valves .

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

The Filter is made up of 
a cylindrical body, a '' diversion '' head 
fitted with: Drain cock, hydraulic motor with a manual control device, and a 
filtering unit
Disassembly of the Diversion Head

Close the filter inlet (V1), outlet (V2) valves and valve 
 (V3), if fitted

Release the nut (C) and the lock screw (D) on the drain cock 46, 
 in the diversion head 1, open the 
drain cock and let the diversion chamber drain the figure shows the drain cock 
open

Loosen the nut on the return pipe 91, of the hydraulic motor the diversion chamber will now empty through the drain 
cock

Place a suitable container by the drain 
plug ( 12 ) in the filter body ( 2 ) unscrew and remove the drain plug 
with its copper gasket ( 13 ) from the filter body and let the oil remaining in 
the filter drain

Turn the operating 
indicator (53) on the hydraulic motor a few revolutions this helps to empty the 
filter completely

Close the drain cock (46) 
to the position shown and lock the drain cock with the lock screw and nut

قم بفك قابس التصريف (12) 
مع الحشية النحاسية (13) مرة أخرى في جسم الفلتر (2)

Close the pressure drop 
indicator isolator cocks (A) and (B) located on the filter body (2)

Disconnect the contactor 
(E) and pipes (A) and (B) to the pressure drop indicator

Disconnect and reove the 
feed pipe (90) of the hydraulic motor. Undo the four bolts (57) on the return to 
sump pipe and disconnect

افصل أنبوب العودة 
من المحرك الهيدروليكي قم بفك الصامولة (أ) لتحرير الأنبوب (إذا لم يكن مفككًا بالفعل 
انظر الخطوة 3) قم بفك وإزالة الوصلة بالكامل (ب) وأنبوب إعادة التشغيل (91) 
سيتم بعد ذلك إزالتها باستخدام المحرك الهيدروليكي

Insert two M10 screws as 
shown and screw them in alternately half a turn this will then raise the 
hydraulic motor out of the diversion head it can then be lifted clear and 
removed with the return pipe.

قم بفك وإزالة 
اثني عشر مسمارًا (6) لرأس التحويل

قم بتركيب حزام على الرفع 
العروات على جانبي رأس التحويل. ارفعه باستخدام كتلة ومعالجة أو 
تقوم معدات الرفع المناسبة الأخرى بوضع رأس التحويل على قاعدة خشبية 
حماية وجوه شفة
تفكيك وحدة التصفية

Screw two M12 eye bolts into two opposite holes in 
 the diversion cover (24). Lift out the filtering unit with a strap using the 
 same lifting equipment as in step 15. Let any remaining oil drain away 
 and place the filtering unit horizontally on a wooden base.

Turn the filtering unit 
upside down on the wooden base unscrew and remove the four screws (33), and 
washers (34), from the full flow cover (28), remove the cover

Remove the full flow 
filter elements (30), one by one (Each element consists of two parts)

Turn the unit and place 
two supports (A), under the four rods (32) for the full flow elements so the 
sleeve (18), will be (free)

Unscrew and remove the 
four screws (33) a washers (34) from the diversion cover remove the cover

Remove the diversion 
filter elements (29) element consists of two parts remove diversion companion 
spacer (25)

Lift out the distributor 
(16), holding the driving (21), with one hand and guiding it with the other hand. 
 Place the distributor carefully on wooden bench.

Separate the sleeve (18), 
from the spacer (26), by pulling it out slowly. Place the sleeve carefully on a 
wooden bench.

The full flow companion 
spacer (27), can be knocked out through the centre hole in the spacer (26), remove 
the full flow companion spacer (27), the springs (38) are kept in place by screws 
fitted to the spacer (26), do not remove the springs
تنظيف وفحص وحدة التصفية

Clean all components (except the filter elements) with 
diesel oil using a soft brush

Remove the last solids retained on the components 
using compressed 
air

Clean the ball bearing (22) fitted on the 
distributor (16) and lubricate it with grease make sure it rotates freely 
replace it if it is seized or worn

To replace the ball bearing (22) remove the circlip 
(23) and then ball bearing

Inspect the condition of the driving pin(21) if worn or bent drive it 
 through with a pin punch and replace it with a new one

Before cleaning keep one full flow and one 
diversion filter element as ''guides'' for the reassembly of the filter halves 
after cleaning

Put the filter element into a cleaning tray filled 
with the cleaning solvent soak the filter elements in the tray for at 15 minutes

قم بإزالة أحد العناصر من صينية التنظيف و 
افصلها إلى نصفين

قم بتنظيف نصف العنصر بفرشاة ناعمة بعد ذلك 
اشطف العنصر إلى نصفين من الجانبين باستخدام مسدس الهواء/الماء مهم جدًا: 
مع الماء الساخن
Dry the element halves with compressed air

Carefully examine the condition and cleanliness of 
the two halves replace any damaged elements always check the filter screen to 
ensure that it is not cracked if the elements were not clean repeat the cleaning 
procedure again increase the time the element halves are in the cleaning tray

Reassemble the element halves and repeat steps 8 to 
11 on the next element from the tray

When all the elements have been satisfactorily 
cleaned and reassembled according to the ''guide'' elements clean the ''guide'' 
elements
Checks before Start up
Check that the following valves are open:
Inlet valve (V1) to the filter
Outlet valve (V2) from the filter

Return to sump line (back flushing) valve (V3) if 
fitted
محبس عازل مؤشر انخفاض الضغط (A وB)

Check that the drain cock (46) on the diversion 
 head is closed
Checks at Start-up
Check the filter for external oil leaks.
Clean them again now.

لاحظ عاجلاً أنه خلال هذا يجب التحقق من درجة حرارة الزيت إلى الفلتر 
أن تكون في مستوى التشغيل الطبيعي.

rows:
Check the pressure drop on the pressure drop 
 indicator it should not be higher than the reference value. If the pressure drop is higher the filter elements may not have been 
cleaned properly the solution is:

Check the rotation of the operating indicator (53) 
 one revolution should not take longer than the reference value.

Check that the oil 
 inlet temperature is normal and that the engine is operating at normal 
 load if one revolution still takes considerably longer than 
the reference value the hydraulic motor has been assembled incorrectly

sections.text: عام

The moatti automaytic lube oil filter should be 
installed in the lube oil system in accordance with good working practices pay 
attention to the recommendations and only use specified materials
Cautions

Ensure that the equipment is 
 installed in according to the instructions given in 
 the manual

Ensure that the pressure drop indicator is connected to the control 
 system of the engine.

Before the first operation through the automatic filter ensure that 
 any possible contaminants from the installation work have been removed 
 from the lube oil system

Don't (flush) the lube 
 oil system and pipework through the automatic filter. A special 
 flushing filter or the manual by-pass filter must be used for this operation
 as chapter (FLUSHING THE SYSTEM)
